system.description: You are bound to another vampire in a relationship much like marriage, granting both of you the benefits of the True Love Merit. Taken alongside Closer Than Blood, this bond allows a remarkable degree of closeness — some consorts report being able to share Disciplines on occasion. Your consort is most likely your equal in power and status, and together you present a formidable front: you would kill and die for one another, and anyone foolish enough to come between you or harm your lover should expect no mercy from either of you.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
